evidence.quote:
Let $A$ be a nonzero unital separable complex $C^*$-algebra, and let $\omega$ be any free ultrafilter on $\mathbb N$. Then $$F_\omega(A)\text{ has no characters}
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad A\cong A\otimes_{\min}\mathcal Z.$$

Let $P$ be a nonzero unital $C^*$-algebra. Suppose that there is a unital $*$-homomorphism $\eta:C\to P$ such that $\eta(\iota e_{11})$ is full in $P$. Then, for some finite $m\ge1$, the maximal tensor power $B=P^{\otimes m}$ contains orthogonal positive contractions $b_1,b_2$ and an element $v_B$ such that $$b_1=v_B^*v_B,\qquad b_2=v_Bv_B^*,\qquad
1_B-b_1-b_2\precsim(b_1-1/2)_+.$$ Consequently there is a unital $*$-homomorphism $$I(2,3)\longrightarrow P^{\otimes m}.$$

outputs.exact_statement:
Let $A$ be a nonzero unital separable complex $C^*$-algebra, and let $\omega$ be any free ultrafilter on $\mathbb N$. Then $$F_\omega(A)\text{ has no characters}
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad A\cong A\otimes_{\min}\mathcal Z.$$

Let $D$ be a nonzero unital complex $C^*$-algebra without characters. There is an integer $m\ge1$ and a unital $*$-homomorphism $$I(2,3)\longrightarrow D^{\otimes_{\max}m},$$ where $$I(2,3)=\{f\in C([0,1],M_2\otimes M_3):
 f(0)\in M_2\otimes1_3,\ f(1)\in1_2\otimes M_3\}.$$

Let $B$ be a unital $C^*$-algebra. Suppose that $a_1,a_2\in B$ are orthogonal positive contractions with $a_1=v^*v$, $a_2=vv^*$ for some $v\in B$, and that, for some $\varepsilon>0$, $$1_B-a_1-a_2\precsim(a_1-\varepsilon)_+.$$ Then there is a unital $*$-homomorphism $I(2,3)\to B$.

Let $A$ be a nonzero unital separable $C^*$-algebra.*

1.  *If $D\subset F_\omega(A)$ is separable and contains the ambient unit, then for every $m\ge1$ there is a unital $*$-homomorphism $D^{\otimes_{\max}m}\to F_\omega(A)$.*

2.  *$A\cong A\otimes_{\min}\mathcal Z$ if and only if $F_\omega(A)$ contains, with the ambient unit, a separable subhomogeneous $C^*$-algebra without characters.

If $a,b\in B_+$ satisfy $a\precsim b$, then for every $\delta>0$ there is $z\in B$ such that $$z^*z=(a-\delta)_+,
 \qquad zz^*\in\operatorname{Her}(b).$$

Let $\alpha:M_3\to B$ and $\beta:M_2\to B$ be completely positive contractive maps with commuting ranges, satisfying $\psi(x)\psi(y)=\psi(1)\psi(xy)$ for $\psi=\alpha,\beta$. If $\alpha(1_3)+\beta(1_2)=1_B$, there is a unital homomorphism $I(2,3)\to B$.

Let $M\subseteq B(H)$ be a von Neumann factor with $1_M=1_H$, and let $B\subseteq M'$ be a unital algebra. The multiplication map $$M\odot B\longrightarrow B(H),\qquad a\otimes b\longmapsto ab,$$ is injective. Consequently, multiplication is injective on the complex algebraic tensor product of any finite family of commuting von Neumann factors on the same Hilbert space, all with unit $1_H$.

Let $\pi:B_1\otimes_{\max}\cdots\otimes_{\max}B_q\to B(H)$ be an irreducible representation, where the $B_j$ are nonzero unital $C^*$-algebras. The weak-operator closures of the represented tensor legs are commuting von Neumann factors. The same is true after grouping the legs according to any partition into nonempty blocks.

Let $D$ be a nonzero unital $C^*$-algebra without characters. There is a finite-dimensional real subspace $V\subseteq D_{\mathrm{sa}}$ such that the image of $V$ contains a noncommuting pair in every nonzero unital representation of $D$.

Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional real vector space with $m=\dim_{\mathbb R}V\ge2$. For every integer $r\ge1$, there are $n\ge1$ and tensors $x_1,\ldots,x_r\in V^{\otimes_{\mathbb R}n}$ with the following property: whenever $P_j:V\to E_j$ are real linear maps of rank at least two, the tensors $$(P_1\otimes\cdots\otimes P_n)(x_i),
               \qquad 1\le i\le r,$$ are linearly independent over $\mathbb R$.

Let $D$ and $V$ be as in Lemma 10. For each $r\ge1$, there are $n\ge1$ and selfadjoint elements $x_1,\ldots,x_r\in D^{\otimes n}$ whose images are complex linearly independent under every irreducible representation of $D^{\otimes n}\otimes_{\max}B$, for every nonzero unital $C^*$-algebra $B$. Here the elements $x_i$ occupy the first $n$ tensor legs.
If $D$ is a nonzero unital $C^*$-algebra without characters, then some finite maximal tensor power $P$ of $D$ contains a full element $w$ satisfying $w^2=0$ and $\|w\|=1$.

For every nonzero unital $C^*$-algebra $D$ without characters, there are an integer $m\ge1$, the maximal tensor power $P=D^{\otimes m}$, and a unital $*$-homomorphism $\eta:C\to P$ such that $\eta(\iota e_{11})$ is full in $P$.

For $k\ge1$, the algebra $C^{\otimes k}$ identifies with $$\left\{
 f\in C([0,1]^k,M_2^{\otimes k}):
 f(t)\in\bigotimes_{i=1}^k E_i(t)
\right\},
\qquad
E_i(t)=
\begin{cases}
M_2,&t_i>0,\\
\mathbb C1,&t_i=0.
\end{cases}$$

For every $k\ge1$, there is a point-norm continuous family of unital $*$-homomorphisms $$\theta_r:M_2\longrightarrow M_2^{\otimes k},
\qquad
r\in\Delta_{k-1}
=\left\{r\in[0,1]^k:\sum_i r_i=1\right\},$$ whose range uses only the tensor factors indexed by $\{i:r_i>0\}$. At the $j$-th vertex, $\theta_r$ is the $j$-th coordinate inclusion.

Let $P$ be a nonzero unital $C^*$-algebra. Suppose that there is a unital $*$-homomorphism $\eta:C\to P$ such that $\eta(\iota e_{11})$ is full in $P$. Then, for some finite $m\ge1$, the maximal tensor power $B=P^{\otimes m}$ contains orthogonal positive contractions $b_1,b_2$ and an element $v_B$ such that $$b_1=v_B^*v_B,\qquad b_2=v_Bv_B^*,\qquad
1_B-b_1-b_2\precsim(b_1-1/2)_+.$$ Consequently there is a unital $*$-homomorphism $$I(2,3)\longrightarrow P^{\otimes m}.$$
Every nonzero unital $C^*$-algebra $B$ without characters contains a separable $C^*$-subalgebra $D$ without characters and with $1_D=1_B$.
